Overview

SEND Life Transition is a YouTube channel and podcast for families and professionals helping young people with special educational needs and disabilities move into adult life. It draws on twenty years of working in specialist SEND, residential and college settings.

The problem

Transition is the point where families most need plain, practical guidance, and where most of what exists is either clinical or marketing.

Approach

  • Content pillars set first, so every episode answers a real question families ask.
  • Scripted, then recorded in one take where possible, to keep the tone honest.
  • A repeatable production workflow so episodes get made alongside a full-time job.

Tools

  • YouTube
  • Podcast production
  • Scripting

Outcomes

  • Channel live on YouTube

What I learned

The families watching do not need me to be polished. They need me to be specific.
